title: Doktor KosMed public-site accessibility review
target_standard: WCAG 2.2 AA (targeted checks; not a conformance claim)
scope: Localized public-site service pages rendered by Vite and Nitro
Skip-link focus order, visibility, target focus, and accessibility-tree roles/names
method: Source review plus dedicated Playwright keyboard and Axe E2E checks using synthetic public-site data.

findings.observation: The localized skip link is the first page control, becomes visible on focus, and moves focus to the single main landmark. Playwright exposes its localized name, the named navigation, and main landmark in the browser accessibility tree. The owner manually confirmed the visible link and focus transfer.
findings.verification_needed: The exact live Narrator announcement was not recorded; broader assistive-technology testing remains necessary before any WCAG conformance claim.

findings.observation: The localized service catalog on Vite and Nitro and the localized Vite error state passed the configured Axe rules in Chromium and emulated Mobile Chrome.
findings.verification_needed: This route sample and rule set do not evaluate every WCAG 2.2 AA criterion.

limitations: The owner reported the visible link and focus transfer, but the exact live Narrator speech output was not recorded; accessibility-tree assertions do not replace broader assistive-technology testing.
Only selected public catalog/error states were audited; this is not a complete WCAG 2.2 AA audit.
Local Firefox and WebKit Playwright binaries are absent; the dedicated CI spec runs only in Chromium, so cross-browser behavior remains unverified.
Mobile Chrome used an emulated viewport, not a physical device.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.scope: Targeted mobile public header, catalog filters and keyboard bypass, after catalog data is ready.

live_baseline.chrome: On /ru/services, Tab reached the menu before the language switch despite the opposite visual order. The open menu covered the center of a focused service link.
live_baseline.firefox_text_only_200_percent: Brand text extended to 403 CSS px and the open menu extended its link text left of the viewport on the measured public catalog pages.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.fix: Align mobile DOM and visual order, let the expanded native disclosure occupy normal flow, and wrap brand and menu text at narrow widths.

checks: Actual Tab order and visible focus
Menu opens and leaves subsequent focused controls exposed
Brand and menu text fits viewport
Skip link transfers focus to main
Catalog query and keyboard reset restore results and focus
Sampled reduced-motion scroll and animation settings
isolated_vite.teardown: Owned browser profiles and loopback services stopped.

mobile_reflow_follow_up.regression: The existing Playwright accessibility spec now exercises real forward and reverse Tab through the mobile services header and catalog for both locales and Vite/Nitro. It tests that the open menu does not cover the focused search control or service link.
remaining: Live Narrator announcements and native Safari
Full WCAG 2.2 AA audit and full staging validation

loading_focus_follow_up.runtime: Isolated Vite using synthetic catalog responses
loading_focus_follow_up.method: Hold the required catalog response. Press Tab and Enter to focus main while loading, then release the response and read the active element and the original node identity.

baseline.observation: After success, the browser retained #main-content, focused the body and returned to the skip link on the next Tab.

loading_focus_follow_up.fix: Keep the shared header, native skip link and main landmark mounted across request states for a single pathname.
loading_focus_follow_up.regression: Playwright holds a real synthetic catalog response in both Vite locales and checks the same focused main before and after success, including the next Tab stop.
remaining: Full WCAG 2.2 AA and staging acceptance
